records.observation:
Complete1357-line javap displayed consecutively1–340/341–680/681–1020/1021–1357. JToolBar implements ToolBarStatus, resolving concrete type for action dialog casts in normal TimelinePanel wiring. Constructor captures window/viewport/Y scrollbar/tree/maps/time scrollbar/model/row adjustments, creates buttons, THEN installs itself on viewport. Constructor does not initAllButtons; public init explicitly does so (TimelinePanel.init previously read). No listener registration on time model/tree in this class; resets are explicit caller operations, not an automatic model observer.
Resources via runtime getClass().getResource absolute /images paths; each icon missing yields text fallback, Insets2 all sides, small separator5x5 plus repeated default separators. Added button order Up/Down, Mark/Move/Delete, Expand/Collapse, Backward/Forward, Undo/Out/Home/In/Redo, SearchBackward/Init/Forward, Refresh/Print/Exit. Commit button CREATED with icon/fallback/margin/tooltip/mnemonic/listener but NEVER added to this toolbar; exposed getter and used as indirect doClick target. Mnemonics Up38/Down40, ExpandE/CollapseC/CommitD, Back37/Forward39, UndoU/OutO/HomeH/InI/RedoR, SearchB/S/F, RefreshD. Commit and Refresh shareD, but Commit not inserted here. No custom key dispatch or focus-mode panel creation here.
Bindings: vertical actions receive Y scrollbar, horizontal time scrollbar, zoom this+model, search this+viewport. Mark/Move/Delete root+this+tree; Expand/Collapse this+tree; Commit root+this+viewport+maps+row adjustments. Refresh tree+same hidden Commit; Print noargs; Stop captured root. Getters return actual mutable buttons; delete field also public, no defensive wrappers.
initAllButtons enables Up/Down/Mark, disables Move/Delete, resets tree buttons, enables horizontal Back/Forward, resets zoom, enables allthree Search/Refresh/Exit, disables Print. No boundary-sensitive navigation/search enabling, no InfoBox check for SearchInit. Repeated init can disable Move/Delete despite existing marks (does not inspect mark state).
resetZoomButtons reads current rounded getZoomLevel ONCE: In enabled level<30, Home level!=0 (including negatives), Out level>0; Undo and Redo enabled iff respective stack nonempty, independent of level. This resolves prior navigation receipt pending condition: ordinary initialized toolbar disallows Out at0 although ActionZoomOut alone accepts0. Negative-level Home is enabled here but ActionZoomHome warns/rejects; static inconsistency, not proof default user click creates negative state. Previously read direct ViewportTime Shift-click calls ModelTime.zoomOut without action limit and then resets buttons; model can divide scale while actual extent clamps. No new history policy: new zoom branches preserve redo, so reset keeps redo enabled when stack still populated. Home disabled at0 can prevent using THIS button to clear nonempty history at0; undo/redo remain available. Other callers/inputs not globally ruled out.
resetYaxisTreeButtons enables Expand/Collapse from tree.isLevelExpandable/isLevelCollapsable, always enables Commit; does not reset Mark/Move/Delete, detect pending edits, rebuild maps or repaint. No worker cancellation, dispose override, null guards, listener cleanup or exception isolation. Actual mark/move/delete, tree/maps/row adjustment internals remain separate unread items.
